data.long_meaning: The meaning of Jephthah is recorded in name-lists as “God has judged”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jephthah expresses “God has judged”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jephthah total 40, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: יפתח הוא שם עברי הנגזר מהמילים יהוה ופתח, ופירושו הוא האל הפתיח את דרכו, כשםו של שופט בתנ''ך, שחי בתקופת השופטים והיה בן גלעד

in_greek.name: Ιεφθαέ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ιεφθαέ είναι ελληνική μεταγραφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος יפתח, που σημαίνει ο Θεός ανοίγει τον δρόμο, και αναφέρεται στο πρόσωπο του Ιεφθαέ, που ήταν ένας από τους δικαστές του Ισραήλ στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη

in_latin.name: Jepthe
in_latin.long_meaning: Jepthe est nomen Hebraicum, quod significat Deus aperit viam, et refertur ad persona Jepthe, qui fuit unus ex judicibus Israel in Veteri Testamento, et qui duxit populum Israel ad victoriam contra Ammonitas
